messages:
morgan: Heads-up: CI alert — image signature verification failed for registry.redwood-prod/vector-ingest:2026-03-20-rc2 during SBOM ingestion. Looks like the image manifest layered signature doesn't match the stored provenance.

morgan: log excerpt:```
verifier: signature_verify failed: key_id=projects/redwood/kms/keys/artifact-signer-v1, error=signature mismatch
image: sha256:8f3a...
manifest: signed_by=artifact-signer-v1, verified=false
```

deploy-bot: [auto] block-deploy triggered: image verification failed for vector-ingest:2026-03-20-rc2. Deploys to prod and qa paused. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-314. :warning:

dan: @morgan can you confirm whether this is a build-attestation mismatch or an upstream tamper? Any alt signatures in the registry?

morgan: initial triage: builder image from buildpool-5 (internal) shows matching local digest, but signature blob differs from the SBOM-attested signature. Not yet sure if signing key rotated or compromised.

kyle-sre: freezing deploys on our end, added network ACL to prevent new pulls of that tag. Will also snapshot registry objects. :lock:

ashley-qa: pulling previous canary image (rc1) for smoke. If it's only rc2 affected we can rollback canary traffic. Trying `docker pull` now.

morgan: good — please dump manifest and signature blob and attach to INC-2026-314. Steps I ran:```
# inspect manifest
crane manifest registry.redwood-prod/vector-ingest:2026-03-20-rc2 --platform=linux/amd64 > /tmp/manifest.json
crane sigverify registry.redwood-prod/vector-ingest:2026-03-20-rc2 > /tmp/sig.txt
```

ops-automation: Ran a quick KMS check: key artifact-signer-v1 rotation record shows an unplanned import at 2026-03-19T22:11Z from builder-ops service account. Creating audit alert task.

morgan: @ops-automation can you pull the KMS access logs + IAM change history and drop in the ticket? We need to know which principal signed the bad blob.

ops-automation: attached in INC-2026-314: KMS logs show Sign operation by serviceAccount:builder-ci@redwood-prod with fingerprint commit=0a7f. No explicit IAM denies.

dan: if builder-ci signed it, maybe the builder image compromised or a rogue worker used the key. We should rotate the signing key and revoke tokens used by builder-ci. Also audit recent build runner logs.

morgan: Agreed. Immediate containment: 1) rotate artifact-signer-v1 (generate artifact-signer-v2, update signer role), 2) revoke builder-ci ephemeral credentials, 3) quarantine the image tag and all derived images, 4) trigger full SBOM re-ingest for tags pushed in last 48h.

kyle-sre: On it: rotating key now, updating registry signing webhook to accept v2 only after rollout. Will post rotation fingerprint. ETA ~7 min.

dan: Adding RBAC change: tighter grant for kms.sign to only build-runner-role, plus MFA enforce for any manual signer. We'll open a PR for iam-policy and fast-approve via infra-oncall.

ashley-qa: rc1 smoke passed. Rolling canary back to rc1 and unpausing non-prod pulls. Prod still blocked.

morgan: Legal/Compliance: @legal-bot do we need external notification for this class of artefact signature mismatch? We may be containing but need to track customer-impact surface.

legal-bot: Filing for review. Recommendation pending severity classification. If there's no evidence of exfiltration or secret compromise, we treat as internal supply-chain integrity incident. Will advise if customer notice required.

ops-automation: Rotation complete. New key id=artifact-signer-v2, fingerprint=sha256:3b9a..., and old key set to disabled for sign. Pushed RBAC rollback prevention guard.

morgan: Next actions: rebuild vector-ingest from pinned commit hash (CI job id 1427), sign with v2, run reproducible build check, regenerate SBOM and re-publish. Also run dependency vuln scan for that build artifacts.

dan: I'll trigger the rebuild job with isolated runner group and attach the attestation to the ticket. Also adding e2e verify step: verify signature after push and verify digest matches local.

kyle-sre: Postmortem owners? Suggest morgan (security), dan (eng-runtime), kyle-sre (infra), ashley-qa (qa). We'll schedule RCA in 48h and list mitigation: add signature verification to CI gating, alert on KMS-sign unusual principals, and archive registry-level provenance history for 90 days.

morgan: Also adding: update runbook to include immediate KMS access audit and a playbook to disable specific builder runners.

ashley-qa: Ticket INC-2026-314 updated with artifacts and smoke results. Marking affected services: vector-ingest, batch-transformer (derived).

morgan: Thanks all. Low-level follow-ups in the ticket. We'll keep this thread for quick sync. :thumbsup:
